title: Prato feito: rice, beans and grilled chicken
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Chop half the onion and 2 garlic cloves, sweat them in 1 tsp oil, add the rinsed beans and 150 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few beans.
Marinate the chicken with the remaining garlic, lime juice, salt and pepper and cook in a griddle pan for 5–6 minutes per side.
Cut the tomatoes and remaining onion into a salad and dress with lettuce and salt.
Serve the rice, beans, chicken and salad together on one plate.
